name: glm-5.3-flash-nvfp4-dflash2-tp2
description: GLM-5.3-Flash RedHatAI NVFP4, TP2, DFlash2 block-diffusion drafter k=7 — the fastest published dual-Spark GLM lane for code/structured output.

source.title: GLM-5.3-Flash NVFP4 (RedHatAI) — TP2 + DFlash2 k=7
source.author: seanlinmt / tonyd2wild (recipe + image), incoai (drafter)
requirements: Everything from glm-5.3-flash-nvfp4-tp2, plus the drafter repo incoai/GLM-5.3-Flash-DFlash2 on both nodes (staged automatically; Pin pins its commit and injects it into speculative_config).

Image ghcr.io/tonyd2wild/vllm-glm53-flash:sm121-v11-dflash2 — the author's launcher was written for digest sha256:4def0ef644cb…85a6; Pin resolves the tag and warns when it no longer points at that digest.

Required patch, checked before every activation: mod glm53-sm121-sparse-attn on both nodes. The launcher mounts docker/sparse_attn_indexer_kpool_sm121.py from the recipe repo over the image's vllm/model_executor/layers/sparse_attn_indexer_kpool.py; without it the engine dies on decodes past ~24K context. Download that file, then: tsm mods file-patch glm53-sm121-sparse-attn --file sparse_attn_indexer_kpool_sm121.py --target /usr/local/lib/python3.12/dist-packages/vllm/model_executor/layers/sparse_attn_indexer_kpool.py
vm.swappiness=0 on both nodes (the author calls it mandatory for GB10 unified memory; keep swap on). `tsm doctor` shows the persistent setting.
Headless nodes: at ~0.85 of 121 GiB per node the margin is a few GiB, and a desktop session takes part of it.
notes: Settings follow the author's DFlash2 launcher: max-num-batched-tokens 8192 (a larger prefill batch raises the startup memory peak), kv-cache-dtype fp8_e4m3, block size 2304, eager, marlin MoE, VLLM_ENGINE_READY_TIMEOUT_S=3600 for the ~15 min boot (TwinSpark's own health wait is runtime.health_timeout_s; `tsm plan` shows both).

Not copied from the launcher: its NIC names, addresses and NCCL_IB_HCA (TwinSpark sets those from controller.yaml), and its chat template / reasoning parser glm45 with thinking off by default — this profile keeps deepseek_r1 and thinking on; change behaviour.reasoning_parser if your clients expect glm45.
DFlash2 acceptance is content dependent: ~7/7 on structured text, ~5/7 on code, ~1-2/7 on prose.
